description: Use this when the user wants a specific person's work email address at a company: to contact, reach out to, cold-email or follow up with them, or to fill in a missing email on a lead. Needs the person's first and last name and the company's website domain, or the company's LinkedIn page when the domain is unknown. Returns the address with a status: verified (the mail server accepted that mailbox), catch_all, predicted or not_found. Do not use for personal addresses such as Gmail, for phone numbers, or for someone with no company. Costs 1 credit only when the result is verified. Misses, catch-alls, and cached repeats are free and still return at 0 credits. A billable result fails at 0 balance with an insufficient_credits error. This stores the lookup. It does not delete or modify the person's data.

company_domain.description: Company website domain, such as example.com. Optional when company_linkedin_url is set.

company_linkedin_url.description: The company's LinkedIn page. Resolved to a domain only when company_domain is empty. Costs 1 credit only when a domain is found.

name: find_email

credits_used.description: Credits this call spent. 0 for a free outcome.

email.description: The address found, or null when there is none to return.

needs_verification.description: True when the address could not be confirmed, for example on a catch-all domain.

status.description: Outcome of the lookup: verified, catch_all, predicted, not_found, insufficient_evidence, invalid_input or error. Only verified is a confirmed mailbox.

title: Find one email
